name: Anthony Towns
cooked: Concretely: in the context of bugs like CVE-2026-117350 (tcp stack bug in bitcoin), CVS-2026-117349 (protocol bug in bitcoin) and CVE-2026-98432 (tcp bug in linux), isn’t it more sensible for home users not to be listening for incoming connections, as a precautionary measure?
topic_title: TCP hole punching for Bitcoin nodes behind home NATs?
